title: Dear Readers, My Screen Cracked!
subtitle: It won't be strictly speaking daily for a bit
text:
The Frontier Psychiatrists newsletter is…or was…a daily health related Newsletter. That daily nature was something that I started doing on a lark, really. It is written by just me—Owen—and it seemed like a good way to build habits to have to write every day. I have a few real themes here. One is the value of relentlessness, and the counterpoint to that is an acceptance of what is, even if it is imperfect.

Subscribe now

“Getting ok” with imperfect writing seemed like a good enough thing to write about. Well, this, too, was something the fates decided to call me out for. Hubris!

The screen of my laptop cracked. I don't know If my kids did it. I am on vacation. I am just going to hard pass on figuring out why it happened, and accept that it did.

I radically accept this screen crack situation. I am not going to crank out daily content again till I am back home. I am typing this on my phone, for now. That is inefficient. It forces me, were I to try to keep at it for its own sake, to not try anything ambitious. Thusly, this newsletter won’t be daily for a little while. You will tell me what you think. I have plenty of content to catch up on! Lots of articles to go back and read exist. Enjoy yourselves!

I will lean in. I will not ruminate on a repair vs replacement decision till I return to NYC, and that will be that. What will be, will be.

Thanks for reading. I will really appreciate any paid subscriptions because this is an expensive repair I have coming.
